decisions.reason: As a recently launched service that extends the firm’s core cloud, contact-centre and digital-transformation offer, management would be inclined to continue backing it because investments are fresh, it fits the announced strategic direction, and any weak early uptake can still be framed as a normal ramp-up issue.

Because this platform is close to the established business and was given its own webpage, the firm has made a visible commitment to it and, under escalation of commitment, would likely retain it in 2024 rather than reverse course after only a short time on the market.
